assumptions.text: The Dispute API Fargate tasks are sized at 1 vCPU / 2 GB with 2 desired tasks.
assumptions.reason: SRS states ~25 concurrent users at peak (Section 2.2) but does not specify throughput or task count. Two tasks at 1 vCPU / 2 GB provide headroom for month-end peak (60 disputes/day, REQ-15) and allow one task to absorb load during a rolling deployment.

assumptions.text: The RDS gp3 storage is provisioned at 100 GiB.
assumptions.reason: SRS gives ~870 disputes/month, ~1,500 drafts/month and ~25,000 audit events/month (Section 6) but does not specify database storage. 100 GiB covers 2 years of growth at 3x (REQ-23) with room for indexes and WAL, staying above the 20 GiB minimum.

assumptions.text: The Web Assets S3 Bucket uses SSE-KMS with the customer managed key.
assumptions.reason: SRS classifies all data as Confidential-Financial (Section 6) and requires encryption at rest (REQ-22, C-05); the KMS CMK is applied consistently to all buckets.

assumptions.text: The Cognito access token validity is set to 1 hour and the refresh token to 8 hours.
assumptions.reason: SRS does not specify token lifetimes. 1-hour access tokens limit the blast radius of a stolen token; 8-hour refresh tokens cover a full business-hours session (07:00–19:00, REQ-19) without requiring re-authentication.

assumptions.text: The Glue crawler is triggered on-demand by the Ingestion Lambda after each monthly billing file arrival rather than on a fixed schedule.
assumptions.reason: SRS requires files to be queryable within 4 hours of arrival (REQ-18); a fixed daily schedule could delay partition registration. On-demand trigger ensures Athena partitions are updated immediately after validation.

assumptions.text: Partner agreement terms are stored as structured text in the Dispute Database (RDS) and/or as extracted text from PDFs via Textract.
assumptions.reason: OI-04 notes that it is unconfirmed whether partner agreements are structured data or PDF only. The design accommodates both: structured data in RDS and PDF text via Textract (REQ-14), so no redesign is needed when OI-04 is resolved.

assumptions.text: The API Gateway Webhook Endpoint uses an HTTP API (not REST API) with a Lambda authorizer for HMAC validation.
assumptions.reason: SRS requires webhook payload authentication (Section 5) but does not specify API Gateway tier. HTTP API is sufficient for webhook ingestion and is cheaper than REST API (REQ-25); WAF is not added as the webhook is authenticated by HMAC and not a stated compliance requirement.

assumptions.text: CloudTrail logs are stored in the Billing Data S3 Bucket under a /cloudtrail/ prefix rather than a dedicated bucket.
assumptions.reason: SRS requires all data to remain in us-east-1 (C-04) and a 7-year audit trail (REQ-21). Consolidating CloudTrail logs into the existing bucket with a lifecycle policy reduces the number of S3 buckets and simplifies KMS key policy management.
